profile.name: Nuno Magalhaes
profile.title: Cybersecurity Architect and Azure Cloud Architect
profile.summary: Senior Windows Administrator and Cloud Arquitect of Azure with focus on Security and Identity
about: I began my career in support and service desk roles before progressing into Systems Administration, managing Windows Server and client environments.
Over time, I expanded into System Center, Azure, and Microsoft 365, focusing on secure deployments and automation using PowerShell and Azure IaC.
I have implemented Microsoft security architectures—including Zero Trust, WAF, CAF, MCRA, and MCSB—across multiple customers to strengthen identity, cloud, and workload protection.
My goal is to continue advancing as a Microsoft‑focused Cybersecurity Architect and Azure Cloud Architect.
